dimensionless_form.value: with s = z, w = Omega/Gamma' and P in units of R/Gamma': dP/dtau = z - P + w x P; steady state P* = (z + w x z + (w.z) w) / (1 + |w|^2)
dimensionless_form.source: Sulai et al., 'Characterizing atomic magnetic gradiometers for fetal magnetocardiography', arXiv 1906.03227 (2019), Eqs. (B1)-(B2), rescaled

tau is dimensionless time. The left side of (B1) is 2 d/dt and the paper does not give how follows
